text_blocks.snippet: Treatments for nerve damage vary depending on the type and severity of the injury, but generally include pain management, physical therapy, and surgical interventions. Pain can be managed with medications like NSAIDs, anti-seizure drugs, antidepressants, and topical treatments like lidocaine. Physical therapy and assistive devices can help improve muscle strength and mobility. In some cases, surgical procedures like nerve repair, nerve grafting, or nerve transfer may be necessary to restore nerve function.
